anti_interference: 别说 True surprise！
knowledge_point: What a + 名词！感叹句型。

anti_interference: 别说 He makes me sick！有时有歧义，指生病。
correct_english: He really disgusts me. / It's disgusting.
knowledge_point: 感到恶心/令人厌恶用 disgust。

anti_interference: 别说 I feel bad inside！
correct_english: I feel really guilty about it.
knowledge_point: 内疚的专业词：guilty。

anti_interference: 别说 I don't care！有时显得有点粗鲁。
correct_english: It doesn't really matter to me.
knowledge_point: 委婉表达“无所谓/不在乎”：it doesn't matter。

anti_interference: 别说 I am disappointed to you！
knowledge_point: 对某人失望，介词一定要用 in 或者 with，不用 to。

anti_interference: 别说 I let go a breath！
correct_english: I'm so relieved to hear that.
knowledge_point: 感到如释重负：relieved。名词形式是 What a relief。

anti_interference: 别说 Don't fire at me！
correct_english: Don't take it out on me.
knowledge_point: 把火撒在某人身上，固定搭配 take it out on sb。

anti_interference: 别说 That makes me awkward！
knowledge_point: 尴尬的场面：embarrassing。awkward 通常指笨拙或冷场。

anti_interference: 别说 I feel terrible！这个是对的，还可以说？
correct_english: I feel awful about what happened.
knowledge_point: awful 和 terrible 是绝佳的近义词。

anti_interference: 别说 I have a cold！其实对的，但还有更生动的。
correct_english: I think I caught a cold.
knowledge_point: 染上感冒用 catch a cold。

anti_interference: 别说 My nose is flowing water！
knowledge_point: 流鼻涕固定表达：runny nose。

anti_interference: 别说 My body is hot！
knowledge_point: 发烧可以说是 have a fever 或更生动的 run a fever。

anti_interference: 别说 My throat hurts！对但普通。
knowledge_point: 喉咙痛极固定说法：sore throat。

anti_interference: 别说 I pull belly！
knowledge_point: 腹泻的医学/常用词：diarrhea（拼写注意）。口语也可说 the runs。

anti_interference: 别说 I am allergic of seafood！介词错误。
knowledge_point: 对...过敏，介词必定搭配 to。

anti_interference: 别说 I want to vomit！太直白了。
knowledge_point: 想吐/恶心，用 nauseous，或者可以说 I feel like throwing up。

anti_interference: 别说 My whole body hurts！
correct_english: My body is aching all over.
knowledge_point: 持续性的酸痛用 ache，all over 强调全身。

anti_interference: 别说 My stomach is not comfortable！
knowledge_point: 胃病/消化不良的统称：upset stomach。

anti_interference: 别说 I go to look doctor！
correct_english: I need to see a doctor.
knowledge_point: 看病必定用 see a doctor。

anti_interference: 别说 I broke my ankle！那是骨折。
correct_english: I sprained my ankle playing basketball.
knowledge_point: 扭伤用 sprain，骨折用 break/fracture。

anti_interference: 别说 Nose bleed water！
correct_english: I've got a bloody nose. / My nose is bleeding.
knowledge_point: 流鼻血的直接短语。

anti_interference: 别说 Doctor give me paper！
correct_english: The doctor wrote me a prescription.
knowledge_point: 处方/药方是 prescription，开处方用 write。

anti_interference: 别说 How to eat this medicine？
correct_english: How often should I take this medication?
knowledge_point: 吃药绝不能用 eat，必须用 take。

anti_interference: 别说 My head is running！
knowledge_point: 头晕目眩用 dizzy。

anti_interference: 别说 Lose sleep！
correct_english: I couldn't fall asleep last night.
knowledge_point: 可以说 have insomnia，但口语常直接说 couldn't fall asleep。

anti_interference: 别说 Tooth hurts！
knowledge_point: 牙疼/头疼/胃疼都有复合词：toothache, headache, stomachache。

anti_interference: 别说 I don't fit water and soil！
correct_english: I'm feeling a bit under the weather.
knowledge_point: 感觉不舒服、微恙，极其高频的习语 under the weather。

anti_interference: 别说 My leg is numb！对，但太医学。
knowledge_point: 口语中说肢体麻木了，常用 go to sleep。

anti_interference: 别说 I am good more！
correct_english: I'm feeling much better now, thanks.
knowledge_point: 病情好转，直接用比较级 better 即可。

anti_interference: 别说 Every two weeks！对的，但不够高级。
correct_english: We hold meetings every other week.
knowledge_point: 隔周、隔天 = every other week/day，更地道。

anti_interference: 别说 The day before yesterday！
correct_english: I saw him the day before yesterday.
knowledge_point: 前天没毛病，大后天是 the day after tomorrow。

anti_interference: 别说 He is twenty something！
correct_english: He is in his early twenties.
knowledge_point: 二十出头 early twenties，二十多岁中 mid-twenties，快三十 late twenties。

anti_interference: 别说 We divide five five！
knowledge_point: 对半分账，平摊：go fifty-fifty。

anti_interference: 别说 90% discount！
correct_english: I can give you ten percent off.
knowledge_point: 中英文打折反义：九折等于减掉 10%，所以是 10% off。

anti_interference: 别说 Ten thousands of people！
correct_english: There were tens of thousands of people there.
knowledge_point: 中文万是单位，英文千是单位，所以几万是 tens of thousands。

anti_interference: 别说 Fifteen to eight！
knowledge_point: 一刻钟用 a quarter，差十五分用 to，过十五分用 past。

anti_interference: 别说 You call wrong number！
correct_english: I'm sorry, you have the wrong number.
knowledge_point: 这是英语电话绝对固定句式。

anti_interference: 别说 The line is busy！
correct_english: The line was busy when I called.
knowledge_point: 占线确实是 the line is busy，英国有时说 engaged。

anti_interference: 别说 Big before yesterday！
knowledge_point: 英语里没有大前天这种专用词，直接算几天前 three days ago 最清楚。

anti_interference: 别说 Buy two get one！
correct_english: This is a buy two, get one free promotion.
knowledge_point: 和 BOGO 类似，完整说法最后要加 free。

anti_interference: 别说 Ten have eight or nine！
correct_english: Nine times out of ten, he's late.
knowledge_point: 英语中习惯说“十次里有九次”。

anti_interference: 别说 Zero down five degrees！
knowledge_point: 零下可以说 minus 也可以说 below zero。

anti_interference: 别说 He is bigger me three years！
correct_english: He is three years older than me.
knowledge_point: 年龄大用 older，不用 bigger。

anti_interference: 别说 This is his second late！
correct_english: This is the second time he's been late.
knowledge_point: 第几次做某事：the + 序数词 + time + 从句。

anti_interference: 别说 One hundred million！
correct_english: The population is about one hundred million.
knowledge_point: 英语没有“亿”的单位，一亿是一百个百万。

anti_interference: 别说 24 hours all day！
knowledge_point: 口语中极高频词：twenty-four seven（全天候无休）。

chinese_intent: 他是个半吊子 / 一知半解。
anti_interference: 别说 He is half bottle！
correct_english: He only has a superficial knowledge of it.
knowledge_point: 表示一知半解，可以形容为 superficial knowledge 或 knows just enough to be dangerous。

anti_interference: 别说 One million of one！
correct_english: It's a one in a million chance.
knowledge_point: 千里挑一/百万分之一的固定表达：one in a million。

anti_interference: 别说 One year and a half year！
correct_english: I've been living here for a year and a half.
knowledge_point: 一年半：a year and a half。一个半小时：an hour and a half。
